flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose by a sizable amount, with Democrats still the favoured party. The projected seat count has also moved to 54-46, up from 53-47, which would mean Democrats gain control, and [[Iowa]] is now a newly predicted flip. In that race the Democrat Josh Turek gained moderate ground, while in [[South Carolina]] the Republican Darline Graham Nordone saw a moderate drop in their chances.
summaries.governor: In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds saw a sizable rise in Polymarket odds. In [[Kansas]], the Republican Ty Masterson lost sizable ground, and the market shows a predicted flip there. The Democrat Aaron Ford also slipped by a sizable amount in [[Nevada]], another predicted flip.
summaries.house: Polymarket's projected House count now stands at 240-195, up from 239-196, which would mean Democrats gain control. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp rise in their chances against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], the Democrat Cait Conley slipped sharply against the Republican Mike Lawler, and the market lists it as a predicted flip.
